_doc: Sound design for 'O Lanche' v2. Read by eleven.py (ElevenLabs requests), mix.py (levels) and synth.py (fallback). 'level' = linear gain of a cue relative to its synth version; ElevenLabs assets are loudness-matched to the synth version first, so levels hold for both sources.

tts._model_note: eleven_multilingual_v2 supports pt-BR and /with-timestamps. eleven_v3 also returns alignment (it is the default of the dialogue-with-timestamps endpoints) and is more expressive; set model_id to 'eleven_v3' or env ELEVEN_TTS_MODEL to try it (stability is snapped to 0/0.5/1 for v3).
tts._context_note: previous_text/next_text = neighbouring lines in film order (script.json). multilingual_v2 takes no language_code, so the context is what keeps short lines ('Valeu!!') in Portuguese. Models listed in context_unsupported_models get no context; any 400/422 is retried once without the optional hints.
tts._short_line_note: Optional: e.g. 'eleven_turbo_v2_5' (takes language_code 'pt') for lines shorter than short_line_chars. Off until tried once with a real key.

leo.desc: young bright male kid voice, energetic

bia.desc: young warm female kid voice, friendly

known_voice_ids._note: Only used when /v2/voices cannot be listed (e.g. --dry-run). Default voices are being retired on 2026-12-31, so the live listing is always preferred.

_lines_note: Per-line overrides keyed by id. eleven.py reads the dialogue TEXT from script.json (the file plan.py times); these texts are only the fallback when script.json is missing.

lines._note: forced, too-bright cheer before the tummy growl

sfx_defaults.suffix: , cartoon sound effect, clean, no music, no speech, no words
sfx_defaults._suffix_note: A cue may set its own 'suffix'; vocal cues (giggle, bark, whimper, sniff, tummy_growl, catch_chomp) drop the 'no speech' part so the model is not told to avoid what it is asked for.

iris_whistle_up.prompt: slide whistle rising quickly, playful 90s TV cartoon intro

birds.prompt: a few light cheerful songbird chirps in a quiet park

footstep.prompt: single soft cartoon footstep on a dirt park path, light kid step

page_flip.prompt: single paper book page turning, crisp

look_up.prompt: tiny cartoon 'bloop' blip as a character looks up

book_thump.prompt: small hardcover book dropping onto a wooden bench, soft thump

tummy_growl.prompt: comical long hungry stomach growl rumble, cartoon
tummy_growl.suffix: , cartoon sound effect, clean, no music

cloud_poof.prompt: soft cartoon puff of smoke appearing, airy poof

drizzle.prompt: tiny gentle rain drizzle pitter-patter from a small cartoon rain cloud

whoosh.prompt: quick soft whoosh of an arm swinging from behind the back

sandwich_pop.prompt: cartoon 'pop' reveal with a tiny bright bell ding

bread_snap.prompt: crusty sandwich bread being torn in half, crisp crunchy tear

sparkle.prompt: magical sparkly glockenspiel twinkle rising, cartoon star eyes

land_thud.prompt: kid landing on a wooden bench seat, soft bump thud

handoff_pop.prompt: tiny soft cartoon bloop pop of an item handed over

bite.prompt: one crunchy bite into a sandwich, cartoon crunch

dog_trot.prompt: small dog paws trotting quickly on a dirt path, light pitter patter

sniff.prompt: small puppy sniffing twice, quick nose sniffs
sniff.suffix: , cartoon sound effect, clean, no music

whimper.prompt: cute puppy pleading whimper, soft high whine, cartoon
whimper.suffix: , cartoon sound effect, clean, no music

giggle.prompt: two young children giggling together briefly, cheerful
giggle.suffix: , cartoon sound effect, clean, no music

toss_whoosh.prompt: small object tossed through the air, short airy whoosh

catch_chomp.prompt: small dog snapping jaws to catch a treat mid-air, quick chomp
catch_chomp.suffix: , cartoon sound effect, clean, no music

bark.prompt: one short happy small puppy bark 'arf'
bark.suffix: , cartoon sound effect, clean, no music

slide_whistle_down.prompt: slide whistle falling downward, cartoon iris-out ending

wink_ting.prompt: single bright tiny bell 'ting' for a cartoon wink

fim_chord.prompt: cheerful ukulele and glockenspiel 'ta-da' ending chord, cartoon button

music._model_note: music_v1 takes composition_plan {positive/negative_global_styles, sections[{section_name, positive/negative_local_styles, duration_ms 3000..120000, lines}]}; music_v2/_v2_5 take {chunks:[{text, duration_ms, positive_styles, negative_styles}]}. The Music API is for paid subscribers: on 401/402/403 eleven.py logs and mix.py uses the synth ukulele score.
music.prompt: Gentle instrumental kids' TV cartoon underscore, 90s Saturday-morning style, 100 BPM in C major: bouncy strummed ukulele, soft xylophone melody, light shaker and pizzicato upright bass. Starts happy and sunny, turns briefly sad and melancholy in A minor (slow ukulele arpeggios, lonely glockenspiel), then bursts back to happy, and ends gently on a soft sustained ukulele chord that decays away (no final hit).
music._end_note: The fim_chord SFX is the film's only 'ta-da'. The score is asked for a soft final chord that has decayed before the stinger, and mix.py fades an ElevenLabs score out from stinger-0.05 s over 0.3 s.

mix._master_note: master: HPF/LPF, capped tanh saturation, integrated loudness to loudness_lufs (BS.1770-4), look-ahead true-peak limiter (4x oversampled, 5 ms look-ahead, 50 ms release) at true_peak_dbtp; leaves headroom for the AAC encode.
mix._voice_unit_note: 'character': if any line of a character lacks a decodable take from one engine+voice, all of that character's lines babble. 'all': the whole cast babbles.
mix._pitch_note: rubberband (high-quality phase vocoder, duration exact) with voices.<who>.formant 'shifted' (formants rise with the pitch: younger timbre) or 'preserved'; falls back to asetrate+atempo if ffmpeg lacks rubberband.
